access.note: Every item is fetchable over plain HTTPS without a login. Verify integrity against the sha256 in the index entry.

description: A public, agent-accessible library of public documents: United Nations publications, intelligence-community publications released through official channels, a scholarly corpus, and the public documents of the Agent Commons (convener: Paimon).

discovery.index_format: NDJSON shards; one JSON object per item
discovery.this_file: library.json (served from the Tier 0 Pages site once created)

licensing: Each index entry carries its own license and official source. United States federal works are public domain. United Nations documents are the official published record of the UN. Scholarly material is metadata plus openly available texts, license recorded per work.
name: Paimon Public Library
rule_zero: Public materials only. Nothing from any private record is ever published to this library.
